title: Rice and Herb Stuffed Greens
subtitle: with pomegranate molasses
description: Blanched chard or Jerusalem sage leaves rolled around a herby rice filling and simmered with tomatoes, onion and pomegranate molasses. Serve hot, at room temperature or cold, with yoghurt.

steps.text: Bring plenty of water to the boil in a wide pot and blanch the leaves for 2 minutes. Drain and rinse in cold water to stop the cooking.
For the filling, blend 2 tomatoes, 1 onion, the herbs, 1 tbsp pomegranate molasses, 1 tsp grape molasses, salt, 1 tsp baharat, lemon zest and the olive oil in a food processor until smooth.
Transfer to a bowl, add the rice and mix and knead by hand until combined.
Scatter 1 sliced onion over the base of a wide, shallow pot and cover it tightly with sliced tomatoes.
Lay a blanched leaf smooth side down, place a narrow strip of filling near the wide end, roll over, fold in the sides and roll tightly into a thin log. Repeat with the remaining leaves.
Pack the rolls in a single tight layer in the pot, scatter over the dried cherries, barberries and salt, and drizzle generously with olive oil.

Mix 2 tbsp pomegranate molasses, 1 tsp grape molasses, a pinch of baharat and salt in a small bowl and pour into the pot. Add water to cover the rolls, put an upturned plate on top, cover the pot and bring to the boil.
Cook over medium heat at a gentle bubble for 1 hour, or until the filling is tender and no liquid remains. Remove the plate after 30 minutes. Rest for 15 minutes, then serve with yoghurt.
